description: Reference-free pairwise preference objective using each response's average token log probability and a target reward margin (paper §2.2 Eq. (4), §2.3 Eqs. (5)–(6)). The paired [B,2,T,V] logits and [B,2,T] target layout follows src/topologies/implementations/losses/cpo.py:7-55; structured-objective bindings follow src/topologies/training/recipes/structured_objective.py:36-50.

examples.title: Train a preference model with SimPO

name: SimPO loss

parameters.additional parameters: **params accepts only beta and gamma; both are required and unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.beta: required positive finite scalar controlling reward difference scale; no universal default is specified (paper §2.2 Eq. (4))
parameters.gamma: required positive finite target reward margin; no universal default is specified (paper §2.3 Eq. (5))
parameters.ignore_index: optional integer token ID excluded from reward sums and response lengths; every response must retain at least one valid token
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating point token logits with shape [B, 2, T, V], chosen response at index 0 and rejected response at index 1
parameters.reduction: none returns one loss per pair [B], mean averages pairs, or sum totals them (default mean)
parameters.targets: integer or integral-valued token IDs with shape [B, 2, T], aligned to logits and on the same device
